players.bio: Armand Erwan Dsihounou Gnanduillet (born 13 February 1992) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Championnat National club Le Mans. Both of Gnanduillet parents originate from the Ivory Coast. The 6 ft 4 in (1.93 m) forward previously played for French clubs Le Havre and Poissy and was an Ivory Coast Under-20 international.

Billal Brahimi (born 14 March 2000) is a professional footballer who plays mainly as a winger for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Santos. Born in France, he plays for the Algeria national team. Club career Middlesbrough Brahimi is a youth product of Cergy Pontoise, Saint-Ouen-l'Aumône and Leixões. He signed for Middlesbrough from Leixões in 2017.
Daouda Traoré (born 22 July 2006) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Spanish Primera Federación club Betis Deportivo, on loan from EFL Championship club Southampton.
Djibril Sidibé (born 29 July 1992) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ligue 1 club Toulouse.

Jérémy Choplin (born 9 February 1985) is a French professional footballer. Currently, he plays in Ligue 2 for AC Ajaccio as a defender. He previously played in Ligue 1 for Le Mans FC and SC Bastia. His brother Romain Choplin is also a footballer playing at the amateur level.

Lamine-Gueye Koné (born 1 February 1989), known as Lamine Koné, is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Championnat National club Le Mans. Born in France, he represents the Ivory Coast national team. Koné began his career with local youth clubs in the Île-de-France region.

Louis Mafouta (born 2 July 1994) is a footballer who plays for Metz on loan from the Swiss club Neuchâtel Xamax, as a striker. Born in France, he represents Central African Republic at international level. Born in Beaumont-sur-Oise, he has played for Saint-Ouen-l'Aumône, Panserraikos, Senlis, Chambly and Chambly II. In January 2019, he moved to Grasse.

Nicolas Kocik (born 4 August 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 2 club Le Mans. Kocik made his professional debut with Valenciennes in a 4–1 Coupe de la Ligue loss to Ajaccio on 13 August 2019. On 5 July 2022, Kocik returned to Le Mans. Kocik's grandfather, Bolec Kocik, was also a professional football player and manager of Polish descent.

Patrick Videira (born 26 April 1977) is a French football coach and a former player who is the head coach of Ligue 1 club Le Mans. In 1996, Videira signed for Chaves in the Portuguese top flight from the reserves of Paris Saint-Germain. After being rarely used, he moved to second division side Maia in January 1998.

Yasser Larouci (born 1 January 2001) is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for Super League Greece club A.E. Kifisia, on loan from French side Troyes, and the Algeria national team.
